sar.narrative: On or about 2016-12-29, financial institution investigation identified unauthorized transactional activity impacting customer C11923 on payment card C11923-K2. Flagged transaction 3583368 totaling $131.30 was executed under patterns characteristic of PatternEnum.CARD_NOT_PRESENT_FRAUD. Graph traversal analysis identified connections across account profiles and device entities (DEV_a6e029ef1f642c67), involving an aggregate suspicious exposure of $131.30. Cardholder inquiry verified the activity was unauthorized. The institution has blocked card C11923-K2, placed linked cards under protective monitoring, and submitted this Suspicious Activity Report pursuant to FinCEN guidelines and Bank Fraud Policy R2/R6.
